target_pattern: Use direct object pronouns (lo/la/los/las, plus me/te/nos) with correct agreement and placement before conjugated verbs or attached to infinitives.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Repeating full nouns and copying English object position.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Spanish replaces direct objects with pronouns and places them before conjugated verbs, or before/attached to infinitives.
target_pattern_formula: Conjugated + infinitive: pronoun before conjugated or attached to infinitive
Neuter lo for ideas/facts (No lo sé)
natural_examples: ¿Quieres ver la película? Sí, quiero verla.
¿Ves las llaves? No, no las veo.
¿Quieres conocer a María? Sí, la quiero conocer.

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as instructed.
drills: Base: Conozco a Juan. -> replace object with pronoun.
Base: Quiero conocer a María. -> rewrite with pronoun before conjugated verb.
Base: Quiero conocer a María. -> rewrite with pronoun attached to infinitive.
Base: Veo las llaves. -> replace with pronoun.
Base: Veo el libro. -> make it negative with pronoun.
Base: ¿Conoces a Carlos? -> answer yes with pronoun.
Base: ¿Conoces a Ana? -> answer no with pronoun.
Base: Quiero ver el partido. -> make question plus pronoun attached.
Base: Quiero ver las fotos. -> make question plus pronoun before conjugated verb.
Base: No sé la respuesta. -> convert to neuter I do not know it.
Base: No entiendo la explicación. -> convert to pronoun.
Base: ¿Ves a los hombres? -> answer yes with pronoun.
Base: ¿Ves a las mujeres? -> answer yes with pronoun.
Base: Queremos conocer a los nuevos compañeros. -> replace with pronoun.
Base: ¿Quieres ver la película? -> answer no with pronoun.

contrastive_discrimination.instructions: Choose the most natural option and write in Spanish.
prompts: I see him. (lo veo vs veo lo)
I see her. (la veo vs veo la)
I want to see it. (la quiero ver vs quiero verla) both valid; write one.
I want to see them. (las fotos) (las quiero ver vs quiero verlas) both valid; write one.
I do not know Juan. (no lo sé vs no lo conozco) person familiarity.
I do not know the answer. (no la conozco vs no la sé) factual content.
I do not know that. (no lo sé vs no la sé) neuter idea.
Do you know María? (¿la conoces? vs ¿lo conoces?)
Do you know them? group of women (¿las conoces? vs ¿los conoces?)
I want to meet him. (lo quiero conocer vs quiero conocerlo) both valid; write one.

common_errors.mistake: Putting object pronoun after conjugated verb
Wrong gender pronoun lo vs la
Wrong number pronoun lo-la vs los-las
Using la sé for generic I do not know
Forgetting personal a in full-noun sentence
Missing accent marks in enclitic stress contexts
common_errors.why_it_happens: Pronoun attachment stress rules are unknown.
